Fix: classification keys on whether the request had been DISPATCHED, not on status code family: any exception raised after dispatch without a captured provider ID = terminal_ambiguous; 401/403 may only retry when raised by the auth handshake before the media request is sent (distinguishable via the adapter's phase - thread a phase marker through the call if needed).

Fix: a 2xx-class or otherwise accepted response without a parseable post ID = terminal_ambiguous for that post identity (the provider may have created it); only transport-level pre-send failures stay retryable.
5. BLOCKER youtube.py:214 (F4 residual) - upload_short omits retries=1 so the client library's default three-attempt loop can reinsert after a post-create readback failure. Fix: pass the same single-attempt/resumable configuration the main upload uses (read how the main path sets retries/next_chunk and mirror exactly); no client-internal retry may wrap the insert boundary.
6. HIGH app.py:1501 (F1 residual) - the referral nominee webhook discards the gateway dispatch result, so a refused CRM create returns crm_outcome=complete without queueing catch-up. Fix: inspect the dispatch result; refused/failed -> crm_outcome=degraded + review-queue entry (webhook still 200); complete only on confirmed success.
7. HIGH orchestrator.py:951 + publish_reconcile.py (F13 residual) - two separate legacy-key readers persist. Fix: ONE shared helper (place it in publish_reconcile.py or a small shared module within ownership) consumed by both the orchestrator and reconcile; delete the duplicate logic.
